## Problem and behavior

Explain the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results, or explain what could not be checked.
- Adapter/accounting changes: use synthetic fixtures; explain bucket semantics, stable record identity, repeated imports and failure handling.
- Dashboard changes: inspect populated, empty and error states at narrow and wide widths, with both themes and affected languages.
- Packaging/integration changes: run `npm run test:package`.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe any changes to commands, source formats, configuration, storage or estimation assumptions. Update the relevant guides and add an `Unreleased` changelog entry for user-visible changes. State any known limitations.

Do not include private journals, conversation content, credentials or identifying local paths. Follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/0then0/AgentKcal/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md); report vulnerabilities through [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/0then0/AgentKcal/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
